This is about rotating an API key. The policy says generating a new API key does not automatically revoke the old one; both keys are valid until old is explicitly revoked. Also, overlap window exists so a key can be rotated without a moment of downtime: deploy new key, confirm it works, then revoke old key. So answer: yes, there is overlap; both keys work until you revoke old. Provide short answer.
